note: PRAYER CLOSET: the season ledger. This file IS the admin panel: names (tag), statuses, colors, pricing, placements, and collaborators all edit here and every closet surface repaints on next load. No deploy per drop. Drop statuses: concept | preview | coming-soon | live | sold-out | archived. Prices stay null until garments are real (the house never sells what it can't ship); when a drop goes live, wire its offering slug and flip status. CHECKOUT: each drop's preorder block carries `shopify` and `square`. Shopify wins when both are set, so a drop moves to the store by pasting one link and never by deleting another. See js/closet.js checkoutOf() and docs/store/SHOPIFY-TAPSTITCH.md.

drops.line: The field set. Sent out sharp and clean, both at once.
drops.why: Matthew 10 is marching orders: go, travel light, be shrewd without losing your innocence. Washed black, washed blue, black — three colorways of one field set, because the mission is real and it is one mission.

briefing.mission: Marching orders: go light, go wise, go anyway.

points.p: The twelve get named before they get sent. Identity precedes assignment: you're a person on the roster, not a number in a crowd.
No gold, no bag, no second coat. The mission funds the mission, and everything you'd over-pack is weight the road doesn't need.
The line on the back of the set: shrewd and clean at the same time. Neither cancels the other: wisdom without edge, innocence without naivety.
Fear gets answered with worth: not one sparrow falls unnoticed, and you are counted down to the hair. Courage here is arithmetic, not bravado.

questions: What would 'travel light' have you put down this season?
Where do you need more serpent, and where more dove?
What's the assignment you keep waiting to feel ready for?
briefing.prayer: Lord, send me sharp and keep me clean. Give me wisdom that doesn't harden and innocence that doesn't fold. I'll go. Amen.

benched.line: The closer. The season ends where the book does: with a sending.
benched.why: Matthew 28 is the Great Commission: all authority, then go. The lightest colorway closes the season the way the resurrection closes the Gospel: walking out in daylight.

briefing.mission: The tomb is open and the credential is signed. Go make disciples.

points.p: The women get the news first and running becomes the right response. The season's lightest colorway starts at a grave that didn't hold.
The commission opens with the credential, not the command. 'All authority in heaven and on earth' is the backing on every assignment that follows.
The assignment is reproduction: disciples who make disciples. Not an audience. A lineage.
The book closes on presence, not pressure: 'I am with you always, even to the end of the age.' The walk is accompanied.

questions: If the authority is His, what exactly are you still waiting to be qualified for?
Who taught you, and who are you teaching?
Where does 'with you always' need to land in your week?
briefing.prayer: Jesus, You hold the authority and I hold the assignment. Walk with me all the days. I'll walk in purpose. Amen.
